talk.name: talk
talk.task_message: No tool calls are permitted. The computed sentence has been spoken. Wait for the answer; do not invent debt, offers or confirmations. Current authoritative phase: {{phase}}.

extraction_schema.name: event
extraction_schema.description:
Tagged-primary-v8. Emit this scalar string for EVERY latest reply, including unknown. Current phase {{phase}}, calendar {{now}}, called person {{first_name}} {{last_name}}. Current speech only, no cached facts. Output tagged rows only, no JSON or sibling fields.
Grammar: k=KIND;c=0_OR_1;optional KEY=VALUE;END. Multiple rows separated by one actual newline, no trailing newline. Required k,c. Keys: p product ID/type/label; a complete positive decimal, at most two fractional digits; d complete verbatim date; v complete requested security answer; t HH:MM; u unfinished component amount/date/both/unknown. No empty, duplicate or unknown keys. Value alphabet: ASCII letters/digits/spaces/underscore/comma/period/slash/colon/hyphen. No escaping; unrepresentable input is unknown. c=1 is complete current positive assertion, excluding quoted/hypothetical/negated/third-party facts. c=0 is unfinished; payment corrections require u, retaining only independently completed a/d. Complete rows omit u.
Date grammar: ISO, day/month/year, today/tomorrow, this/next weekday, month words/ordinals with optional year, weekday plus ordinal, or day-only ordinal referring to the current offer. Preserve wording. Next weekday means following calendar week; this means current week. Numeric DOB means day/month/year; year mandatory.
Literal examples and complete kind set:
k=recipient;c=1;END
k=third_party;c=1;END
k=wrong_number;c=1;END
k=deceased;c=1;END
k=security;c=1;v=14 October 1980;END
k=security;c=1;v=0123;END
k=decline;c=1;END
k=purpose;c=1;END
k=agree;c=1;END
k=confirm;c=1;END
k=proposal;c=1;a=120;d=next Friday;END
k=refuse;c=1;END
k=too_much;c=1;END
k=vague;c=1;END
k=paid;c=1;END
k=dispute;c=1;END
k=hardship;c=1;END
k=plan;c=1;END
k=human;c=1;END
k=stop;c=1;END
k=callback;c=1;d=tomorrow;t=15:00;END
k=unknown;c=1;END
k=question;c=1;END
k=change;c=0;u=date;a=120;END
k=proposal;c=1;a=120;END
k=proposal;c=1;d=November second;END
k=proposal;c=0;u=amount;d=this Friday;END
k=security;c=0;END
Recipient: yes/thats me/speaking/current own name, including greetings/title, is recipient only; generic confirm valid here. Hello alone unknown. Security: v canonical YYYY-MM-DD for DOB, exactly four digits for phone. Preserve leading zero. Introductory words excluded. Explicit phone groups concatenate losslessly: fifteen zero two -> 1502; twenty one zero three -> 2103. Never pad digits or year. Complete self-answer plus any independent question/neutral aside stays security. Missing year/digits is c=0. Questions cannot supply operands; unresolved alternatives require clarification.
Offer yes -> agree to spoken offer, never write consent. Readback yes -> fresh confirm for current terms only. Changed amount/date -> proposal; qualified/withdrawn permission -> change, never confirm. Yes no problem is affirmative. Amount/date alone -> proposal, never refusal. Vague period -> vague. Current arrears already paid -> paid; historical closed/paid off -> dispute. Hardship outranks plan/refusal, retaining voluntary a/d. Lower instalments/new plan -> plan; actual human request -> human; AI enquiry -> question. Relative offering payment -> third_party. Support-phase no -> decline. Independent questions do not erase primary facts. Separate complete amount/date rows may complete one target; never copy old terms as new facts. Raw source is mandatory for security agreement; no financial permission from raw.

extraction_schema.name: raw
extraction_schema.description: Exact latest user utterance, once and verbatim. Always emit this string; never earlier history or an object.

extraction_schema.name: admin
extraction_schema.description: Only independent administrative question acts in the latest utterance: none, ai, scam, purpose, balance, security_purpose, relative_policy, other; space separated if several. Emit none when absent. Security-purpose means why security answers are needed; purpose means why calling; balance means an account balance or amount owed question. Preserve questions accompanying a complete or unfinished primary answer, regardless of comma, semicolon or and. Output only these flags. Use other for an independent question not covered by named flags. A complete self-answer and any independent question are concurrent acts; preserve the answer regardless of question wording. Never put question digits into the requested security answer.

function.name: end_call
function.description:
This is used to technically terminate the call after all the customer's questions have been answered and necessary information has been provided.
- It should only be triggered SILENTLY in the background after the customer-related workflow is complete; never mention this tool or its name to the customer.

llmConfig.systemPrompt: You are a helpful assistant. Your role is to help users with their tasks. Always be friendly and professional. You can use `end_call` tool after you say goodbye to customer to hang up if call about to finish.

workflow.system_prompt: You are Freya Banks digital assistant. Speak English. Follow only computed customer-facing speech and authoritative backend responses. No discounts, waivers or payment plans. Never infer verified identity from speech.
